name: brave-search
description: Web search using Brave Search API. Best for finding technical documentation, recent news, and general web content. Returns structured search results with titles, URLs, and snippets.

name: github
description: Full GitHub integration: read and write code, manage pull requests, issues, branches, and repositories. Essential for any code-related automation workflow.

name: filesystem
description: Read and write local files and directories. Supports text and binary files, directory listing, file search, and path manipulation.

name: postgres
description: Connect to PostgreSQL databases. Run SQL queries, inspect schemas, and manage data. Supports read and write operations with transaction support.

name: sqlite
description: Interact with SQLite databases. Run queries, create tables, insert and update data. Great for lightweight local data storage and analysis.

name: puppeteer
description: Browser automation with Puppeteer. Navigate websites, take screenshots, fill forms, click buttons, and extract structured data from dynamic web pages.

name: slack
description: Send messages to Slack channels, read conversation history, manage channels, and post rich formatted messages with attachments.

name: google-maps
description: Search for places, get directions, find nearby businesses, and geocode addresses using Google Maps API.

name: firecrawl
description: Scrape and crawl websites to extract clean markdown content. Excellent for competitive intelligence, content extraction, and web data collection. Handles JavaScript-rendered pages.

name: tavily
description: AI-optimized web search returning clean, structured results with high information density. Better signal-to-noise ratio than raw search for agent use cases.

name: linear
description: Manage Linear issues, projects, and teams. Create, update, and search issues, assign work, and track project progress programmatically.

name: notion
description: Read and write Notion pages, databases, and blocks. Search your workspace, create structured content, and manage databases as a backend.

name: aws-kb-retrieval
description: Query AWS Knowledge Bases built on Amazon Bedrock. Semantic search over your enterprise knowledge base for RAG workflows.

name: memory
description: Persistent key-value memory store for agents. Store facts, preferences, and context that persist across sessions. Uses a simple knowledge graph structure.

name: sequential-thinking
description: Dynamic problem-solving through structured thinking chains. Helps agents break down complex tasks, revise reasoning, and explore alternative approaches step by step.
